notes: SessionDetailView retains all lifecycle mutation ownership and header confirmation rules; the new shell only composes presentation tabs.
Existing child sections receive the same sessionPublicId, status, and scheduled-only permission guard; no API, backend, or API-client file changed.

Tabs use explicit ids, labelled panels, URL query state, and visited-panel retention for the stateful Submissions and Examiner tabs; lightweight Settings, Participants, and Results panels unmount after navigation to avoid hidden query observers.
Modal content is portaled to document.body so an open dialog cannot be hidden by a visited tab panel; tab changes close the lifted student assignment/import dialogs.
The detail route supplies a Suspense fallback for useSearchParams; the header action rail, ExamPreviewModal, AssignProctorModal, and AnswerDetailModal use semantic theme tokens for dark mode.
The first tab contains compact session summaries only; submissions, examiner assignment, scoring review, grading, and publication remain in separate task-oriented tabs.
